summary: Use Claude safely and effectively for business, research, analysis, and productivity workflows.
audience: Operations, project, sales, marketing, finance, support, research, and other knowledge-work professionals. No software-development experience is required.
recommendedExperience: Three to six months using Claude or a comparable AI assistant in real work
Experience reviewing AI output before sharing it
A practical understanding of hallucinations, context limits, and data sensitivity

exam.delivery: Proctored online or at a test center

domains.name: Prompting and Task Execution
objectives: Create effective prompts for business and technical tasks
Decompose complex requests into manageable work
Iterate prompts using observed output quality
Adapt prompting to analysis, research, drafting, and brainstorming

domains.name: Output Evaluation and Validation
objectives: Evaluate accuracy, completeness, and audience fit
Identify hallucinations, inconsistencies, and bias
Fact-check against authoritative evidence
Choose when human review or additional verification is required
Refine and compare outputs
Select appropriate inline, artifact, and structured formats

domains.name: Product and Model Selection
objectives: Choose among Projects, research, chat, and artifacts
Differentiate Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus roles
Balance quality, speed, and cost
Manage context and memory by restarting, summarizing, or persisting

domains.name: Workflow Integration and Solution Design
objectives: Analyze requirements and candidate use cases
Apply Claude to research, planning, and process improvement
Support solution design and iteration
Augment or redesign existing workflows
Communicate value and limitations to stakeholders

domains.name: Configuration and Knowledge Management
objectives: Configure Projects with instructions and knowledge
Manage uploads and connectors
Write effective persistent instructions
Maintain configurations and sources over time

domains.name: Governance, Risk, and Responsible Use
objectives: Separate appropriate from inappropriate use cases
Apply privacy, data-sensitivity, and regulatory constraints
Follow organizational AI policy
Recognize ethical implications and escalate risk

domains.name: Troubleshooting and Optimization
objectives: Diagnose underperforming prompts and poor outputs
Adjust the approach using feedback and results
Optimize workflows for efficiency and effectiveness

deepDives.label: Prompt Engineering
deepDives.reason: Build prompt structure and iteration from first principles

deepDives.label: Context Engineering
deepDives.reason: Understand context limits and deliberate context assembly

deepDives.label: LLM Evaluation
deepDives.reason: Turn quality judgment into repeatable tests

deepDives.label: Guardrails
deepDives.reason: Layer responsible-use controls around model behavior

deepDives.label: Bias and Representational Harm
deepDives.reason: Recognize and evaluate harmful output patterns

studyPlans.label: 14-day focused plan
milestones: Days 1-2: diagnose and learn the product map
Days 13-14: full mock and targeted review

milestones: Week 3: workflow design and responsible use
Week 4: capstone, mock, and weak-domain review
